# Miauterm 0.1.7-coral

A small follow-up to 0.1.6. It fixes three issues found after release.

## Fixes

- Debian reset no longer leaves an `apt-get` process holding the package-manager lock. Automatic background installation of optional network tools is removed; `resolv.conf` is still configured. Install optional packages yourself with `apt` inside Debian.
- The confirmation dialog's primary action now uses white text on a darker orange background, so the button is readable.
- Extra-key buttons use a 40 dp standard size, closer to Termux, instead of the larger size from earlier builds.
- Startup no longer closes the app when the session list reports no session during notification permission changes.
